{{Quote|Greetings! I'm Captain Thea, commander of the freighter ''Wandering P'orp''.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Thea (Human)|Thea]]|<ref name="SW108" />}}
The '''''Wandering P'orp''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] used by a team of [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Thea (Human)|Thea]]. [[Douzler]] was a member of its crew. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the ''Wandering P'orp'' was present on [[Centares/Legends|Centares]] when its crew salvaged [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] out of [[Rubyflame Lake]].
